notes: Never installed a breaker beyond MKUltra and ran the known IP Block on Server 1 eight times (T5-T8), paying 2 each time to clear the tag and draining from 20 to 3 credits; then clicked for credits for T9-T12 and T14 with nothing to spend them on while the Corp scored three Project Beales and Bellona.

T2 installed AstroScript in Server 2 behind Tollbooth that it couldn't afford to rez (6 credits), so it was stolen at once; after that the plan was solid: Tollbooth plus Closed Accounts kept the Runner broke, and it scored two GFIs and Beale via SanSan.

T1 spent every credit on Ika and Engolo and then facechecked R&D with 0 credits (Anemone trashed 3 cards), then ran HQ with an empty grip against a net-damage Corp; T4 ran the known Anemone at 0 credits and lost 3 more cards; the T11 Loki flatline was largely bad luck.

It kept loading agendas into single-iced Server 3 (Posted Bounty T5, Private Security Force T6 and T10) while the two-ice Server 2 sat empty, and both PSFs went to a Runner who had already shown Ninja could break Archer; it forfeited Hostile Takeover to rez Archer only for Inside Job to bypass it, but it still closed out with two Priority Requisitions.

Good Turntable swap of AR-Enhanced Security for Beale (T9) and steady R&D pressure, but against a Corp stuck at 0-3 credits from T7 it took until T23 to win, with many low-value Archives runs and credit clicks and no further pressure on Server 1.

T4 played Audacity with nothing installed, discarding its whole hand for no effect; it also left R&D with only Data Raven while the Runner took three agendas from it (T5, T7, T8), spent clicks icing an empty Server 1, and landed two Hard-Hitting News without ever punishing the tags.

Fast, aggressive win by T5 (T1 R&D steal of Priority Requisition, Forged Activation Orders, Crypsis through Enigma twice); its one oddity was letting tags pile up from Shadow and Data Raven against a rich Weyland Corp without clearing them.

After T1 it clicked for credits every turn up to 62 credits, never installing a card or making another run, while the Corp advanced and scored Vitruvius, Efficiency Committee x2 and Accelerated Beta Test over multiple turns behind thin ice.

It installed Efficiency Committee (T3) and then Gila Hands (T4) behind Server 2 ice it couldn't afford to rez with 2 credits, and both were stolen; it played no real economy, sat at 0-3 credits, and lost by T7.

Efficient scoring of SDS, SSL Endorsement and SDS behind a single Border Control after an early IPO; it took real risk advancing SDS over two turns (T4-T5) behind one unrezzed ice, and using Building Blocks to put ice on Archives (T9) was odd.

Solid game: Hard-Hitting News crippled the Runner's economy, and it scored Beale, two AR-Enhanced Security and GFI; it left R&D open T1, and using Team Sponsorship to install over its own Commercial Bankers Group (T6) was odd.
Aggressive HQ/R&D pressure won by T7 (trashed Paperclip to steal SDS T2, Black Orchestra through Afshar), with only minor oddities like installing two Clone Chips on T7.

From T6 to T12 it clicked for credits every turn up to 23 credits, discarding each turn and never building a remote, while two Project Beales and Degree Mill sat in HQ behind a single IP Block and were stolen T7, T12 and T15.

It sat at 0 credits all game, never trashed the Corp's Marilyns, CBGs or Jeeves, and ran Gagarin's Server 3 four times at 0 credits (T4) without being able to access; it spent clicks clearing tags instead of contesting the 4-advanced GFI in Server 8 (T9) and Atlas, and only installed MKUltra and Black Orchestra by T13-T16.

Reasonable rig (Houdini, Corroder, Temujin, Cloak), but it won slowly against a passive Corp: many credit clicks with money in hand (T18), repeated empty Archives runs, an early R&D facecheck at 2 credits (T3), and a failed Tollbooth run on T19.

R&D had no ice until T12 and the Runner took agendas from it repeatedly; it spent turns 7-9 and 14 paying to trash Aeneas Informant (about 11 clicks), clicked for credits with a full HQ, and never installed or scored an agenda, so Atlas was stolen twice from HQ.

It kept facechecking the known Cobra on R&D with no breaker (T4, T7, T8, T9), losing 2 cards each time, paid 2 credits a turn to clear the Joshua B. tag, and made many empty Archives runs; against a Corp at 0-2 credits from about T7 it still took until T23 to win.

It played Divert Power on T1 with nothing to derez, left R&D unprotected until T4, and clicked for credits at 16-22 credits on T5-T6; it put Obokata (T8) and then Send a Message (T9) behind only Mlinzi in Server 2, and both were stolen, and the final Send a Message was taken from HQ.

Scored out by T14 behind a single Resistor, helped by a passive Runner, but it sat at 0-4 credits all game, used Sensie draws mostly to discard, and left GFI advancing in Server 3 for about six turns against a Runner holding 20+ credits.

T1 used Stimhack (core damage) on an unprotected R&D, losing Sure Gamble; T2 cleared only 2 of 4 Hard-Hitting News tags and then ran R&D against Argus, ending with 3 tags, 1 credit and 3 cards, and was flatlined by High-Profile Target on T3.
